response: The Pediatric Risk of Mortality (PRISM) score is not reliable in predicting the length of stay in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU). Although PRISM can detect disease severity, its ability to estimate individual length of stay is disappointing. This is because therapeutic interventions can modulate the natural course of the disease, affecting both disease severity and length of stay. However, the inverse correlation between PRISM scores and length of stay might be a useful indicator of the quality of care provided.
